Methodology

How We Compared BTC to XMR Exchange Services

We reviewed services that displayed a working Bitcoin-to-Monero route on November 5, 2026. Every service was assessed using the same seven criteria. We prioritized the complete user journey rather than selecting a winner from a single headline fee or marketing claim.

Live crypto quotes change from minute to minute. A fair price check uses the same BTC input, the same rate type and a narrow time window. Because a static quote would become outdated quickly, this page explains how to repeat the comparison immediately before exchanging.

How to compare live quotes yourself

  1. Open each service within the same 10–15 minute window.
  2. Enter the same BTC amount on every service.
  3. Select the same rate type where possible.
  4. Record the estimated XMR output before sending funds.
  5. Check whether network and service costs are already included.
  6. Compare the live minimum and expected completion conditions.
  7. Recheck the wallet address and final estimate before choosing a provider.

Limitations

Our review used publicly available service information and route-level forms. We did not send a real deposit through every provider. A displayed estimate is not the same as a completed-transaction result, particularly in floating-rate mode.

Step by step

How to Exchange Bitcoin for Monero on ChangeNOW

The standard BTC-to-XMR flow has three main exchange stages, plus a final address and amount check before you start. You need a Bitcoin wallet with enough BTC for the deposit and a Monero-compatible wallet address for receiving XMR.

  1. 1

    Select Bitcoin and Monero

    Open the BTC-to-XMR exchange page. Choose Bitcoin as the asset you send and Monero as the asset you receive. Enter the BTC amount. The form will display the live minimum and estimated XMR output.

  2. 2

    Choose a rate mode

    Use floating mode if you want the exchange to follow current market conditions. Choose fixed mode when it is available and receiving the agreed amount matters more than tracking short-term market movement. Read the conditions shown in the live form.

  3. 3

    Enter your Monero address

    Paste the destination XMR address from your own wallet. Compare the first and last characters with the original address. Do not enter a Bitcoin address or an address for another asset.

  4. 4

    Review, send BTC and track the exchange

    Confirm the pair, amount, rate mode and XMR address. Send the required Bitcoin amount to the generated deposit address. Keep the exchange ID and follow the status until the Monero payout reaches your wallet.

Important: A crypto exchange cannot normally be cancelled after you send the deposit. Blockchain transfers are irreversible, so verify every field before sending BTC.

Two chains

What Changes When You Exchange BTC for XMR?

Bitcoin and Monero are separate assets on separate blockchains. Exchanging BTC for XMR is not a transfer between two addresses on the same network. The service receives Bitcoin and sends Monero to the destination address you provide.

Fact check

Does exchanging BTC to XMR make the transaction anonymous?

No service should promise that the entire exchange becomes anonymous. The BTC deposit remains visible on the Bitcoin blockchain. Monero is designed to conceal sender, recipient and amount data within its own network, but the exchange service may retain transaction records and apply legal or risk-based controls under its policies.

The accurate statement is narrower: after the exchange, the XMR payout uses Monero’s privacy-focused blockchain. That does not erase the public Bitcoin deposit or guarantee anonymity outside the Monero network.

Rates and timing

BTC to XMR Rates, Fees and Exchange Time

§1

Exchange rate

The BTC-to-XMR rate shows how much Monero you can receive for a given amount of Bitcoin. It changes with market prices, liquidity and the selected rate mode.

§2

Included costs

ChangeNOW states that all costs are built into the estimate shown before the swap, with no additional charge added after the exchange. Compare final XMR output rather than a headline fee alone.

§3

Processing time

ChangeNOW publishes an overall average exchange time of about one minute, but a BTC-to-XMR swap can take longer because it starts after the required Bitcoin confirmations and depends on network and liquidity conditions.

Fixed rate or floating rate?

A floating rate follows the market while the exchange is processed, so the final XMR amount can differ from the initial estimate. A fixed rate is designed to preserve the agreed output when the exchange conditions are met. Fixed mode may use a different estimate because the provider takes on short-term rate risk.

Choose based on your priority: potential market movement in floating mode or greater output certainty in fixed mode. Always read the live terms before sending BTC.

Is there a minimum or maximum amount?

The live minimum changes with the pair, network costs and liquidity. ChangeNOW says minimum amounts can be as low as the equivalent of $2, but the BTC-to-XMR form is the authoritative source for the current transaction. ChangeNOW does not publish an upper limit for standard crypto-to-crypto swaps.

Stay safe

BTC to XMR Safety Checklist

Complete these checks before sending Bitcoin. Most address and network mistakes cannot be reversed.

  • Confirm that BTC is the deposit asset and XMR is the payout asset.
  • Use a Monero-compatible receiving wallet that you control.
  • Copy the XMR address instead of typing it manually.
  • Compare the first and last characters after pasting the address.
  • Review the live minimum and estimated XMR output.
  • Check whether you selected a fixed or floating rate.
  • Send exactly the amount requested by the exchange form.
  • Save the exchange ID until the XMR payout arrives.
  • Consider a smaller test exchange when the transaction size justifies it.
  • Contact support through the service’s official domain only.

Never send funds based on an address received through an unsolicited message, social-media reply or search advertisement. Start from the official exchange page and verify the domain.
